gameplay_policy: Character descriptions are presentation content. Native source-compatible AI is the sole gameplay authority; no personality-derived physics or PRNG.

characters.name: Barry Bunkers
characters.personality: Somehow lands in every bunker, even when there isn't one nearby.

characters.name: Chip Shanks
characters.personality: Terrible driver, incredible short game. Master of impossible recoveries.

characters.name: Doug Divot
characters.personality: Destroys more grass than anyone. Every swing resembles an excavation.

characters.name: Wally Whackit
characters.personality: Maximum power, minimum accuracy. Hits it miles, rarely in the right direction.

characters.name: Sir Reginald Slicington
characters.personality: Posh, arrogant, spectacular slice. Blames his caddie for everything.

characters.name: Big Dave Bogey
characters.personality: Huge bloke, tiny putter. Always one shot away from greatness.

characters.name: Hugh Jass
characters.personality: Hits absolutely enormous drives. Has difficulty fitting into golf carts.

characters.name: Al Batroz
characters.personality: Thinks he's the greatest golfer alive. Celebrates every shot, including bogeys.

characters.name: Pat McShank
characters.personality: Irish wildcard. Brilliant one minute, absolutely disastrous the next.

characters.name: Duncan Dufflebag
characters.personality: Carries 40 clubs, can't hit one. Constantly changing equipment.

characters.name: Nick Falco
characters.personality: Ice-cold British professional. Takes forever lining up shots and never smiles.

characters.name: Whappy Gilmore
characters.personality: Former hockey player with a violent swing, explosive temper and outrageous driving power.

characters.name: Shooter McShooter
characters.personality: Smug, finger-gun-waving show-off. Excellent golfer until someone gets under his skin.
